Figure 7.8: PDU channel mode control
Figure 7.8 shows a diagram with possible PDU channel modes. Each
L-PDU
chan-
nel can be in
CANIF_OFFLINE
(no communication),
CANIF_TX_OFFLINE
(passive
mode => listen without sending),
CANIF_TX_OFFLINE_ACTIVE
(simulated transmis-
sion without listening (see [SWS_CANIF_00072]), and
CANIF_ONLINE
(full communi-
cation). The default state is the
CANIF_OFFLINE
mode.
